points.label: lb22
points.name: 5V
points.note: Up to 3 A from a good charger

points.label: lb23
points.name: D+
points.note: USB data, for a microcontroller with USB

notes.pt17: Tells the charger this is a device that wants 5 V (CC1)
notes.pt18: The same for the other way up (CC2)

points.label: lb5s
points.name: BAT+
points.note: To the cell's + (through the protection block)

notes.pt42: The charger chip: charges to 4.2 V, then stops
notes.pt43: Sets the charge current: 2 kΩ is about 580 mA
notes.pt47: On when the battery is full
notes.pt48: Limits the current through the red light
notes.pt49: Limits the current through the green light

points.label: lb8k
points.name: B+
points.note: The cell's + and the board's battery +

notes.pt79: The protection chip: watches the cell's voltage and current
notes.pt7a: Switch that cuts discharging. Stands in for one half of an FS8205A dual MOSFET
notes.pt7b: Switch that cuts charging. Stands in for the other half of an FS8205A

notes.pta3: Stores energy between pulses. Pick one rated for 2 A or more
notes.pta4: Schottky diode: lets current out to the 5 V side only
notes.pta5: Top of the feedback divider: with R2 sets 5 V (0.6 V × (1 + R1/R2))

notes.ptc5: The regulator: drops the input to 3.3 V
notes.ptc6: Input capacitor: keeps the input steady
notes.ptc7: Output capacitor: the regulator needs it to stay stable

notes.ptdk: SDA pull-up. Leave it out if another board already has one
notes.ptdl: SCL pull-up. Leave it out if another board already has one

points.label: lbhu
points.name: SLEEP
points.note: High to run. Join to 3.3 V to leave it on

notes.ptg9: Motor supply capacitor: keeps VM steady when motors start
notes.ptgb: Charge pump capacitor between VCP and VM

points.label: lbkl
points.name: V+
points.note: Servo supply, not the 3.3 V rail

notes.ptjj: Bulk capacitor: covers the servos' current spikes
